Educational flat-design concept map — mind map illustration, square 1:1 format. Italian middle school textbook (scuola secondaria I grado), DigComp A level. Central hub: large rounded rectangle "💻 Raccolta dati da sensori e sistemi IoT", solid fill #006064, white bold sans-serif label, subtle drop shadow. Five branch clusters radiate from the hub with smooth curved lines. Each branch has a colored pill label and 2–5 smaller rounded child nodes:
  • INNESCA [#5E35B1]: "Una centralina meteo fai-da-te con micro:bit" | "Il tuo quartiere respira — ma lo sai quanto bene?" | "Sai quanta CO2 c'è adesso nell'aria della…?"
  • ESPLORA [#1565C0]: "Lo studente progetta e realizza una…" | "es. micro:bit" | "Arduino" | "studente"
  • SPERIMENTA [#E65100]: "sensore / sensor" | "Internet delle cose / Internet of Things (IoT)"
  • AGISCI [#00695C]: "Progetta e realizza una stazione di monitoraggio per…" | "usa un micro" | "Professione futura: IoT Solutions Architect"
  • RIPASSA [#F57F17]: "sensori" | "IoT" | "Internet of Things" | "dati fisici" | "sensore"
Style rules: white background, all labels in Italian, branch nodes solid fill (branch color) with white text, hub accent stripe #006064 on bottom edge only, connecting lines 2px curved matching branch color, no photographs, no decorative frames, no gradients, clean radial balanced layout, Inter/Nunito-style sans-serif typography, WCAG AA contrast, flat vector illustration, 1:1 square.
